images.title: How a mistake *gets caught*
steps: Compares the invoice to the purchase order, reads the calendar back after booking.
Anything on the asks-first list is seen by a person before it goes out.
Every message and change, with its reason. Skimmed daily at first, weekly later.
Any reply saying "that's wrong" goes straight to a person.

images.name: quote
images.text: A person's mistake is usually a one-off. An AI Employee repeats it until you fix the cause, and then *the fix applies everywhere at once.*
